text:
Maya (CS): Heads-up: LatticeLabs emailed that their platform team wants to onboard two new squads (Search infra + Personalization) next quarter. They called out session-scoped embeddings, millisecond tail latency, and heavy nightly batch-ingest. Asking for an ops checklist and quick sizing.
Diego (AM): Good catch. Do we have even rough TPS/QPS sketches? that'll drive Dedicated vs hosted.
Maya (CS): Their doc says Search ~420 rps peak, Personalization ~180 rps, nightly embed job ~300k docs. Also they want HA across eu-west and us-central.
Sam (Eng): 420 rps + multi-region = recommend Dedicated pilot with regional routing + KV caching. Initial suggestion: regional pools in us-central + eu-west, autoscale policy tuned for p95 latency. Rough numbers: ```search peak:420 rps
personalization peak:180 rps
batch embeds:300k docs nightly
SLOs: p50 < 20ms, p95 < 120ms for search```
Priya (Solutions): We'll need to map model selection and quantization strategy. They want higher-quality open models for Personalization and a smaller faster variant for Search. Propose A/B via canary routes and fallback to quantized variant if latency spikes.
Maya (CS): Action: I will coordinate a cross-team kickoff next Tue 10am PT with their infra + SRE. Need a one-pager (config + cost delta) and an onboarding playbook. @Diego can you prepare the pricing scenarios?
Diego (AM): Yep — I'll include committed vs payg, regional egress implications, and an ops discount option tied to a 6mo commit.
Sam (Eng): Sample config to share with their SREs: 
```yaml
deployment: dedicated-regional
regions: [us-central, eu-west]
model_routes:
  - name: search-fast
    model: rdx-search-small-quant
    policy: latency-priority
  - name: personalization-quality
    model: rdx-4-ptq
    policy: quality-priority
batching: auto
kv_cache: prefix + session-scoped
autoscale: min:2 max:12
warmup: prefill-kv-cache: true
```
Maya (CS): Playbook bullets: 1) Kickoff + creds 2) SDK key rotation plan 3) Canary traffic generator + smoke tests 4) KV cache warmup script 5) Runbook for rollback + fallback 6) Success metrics + telemetry dashboards.
Priya (Solutions): I'll author the traffic generator (simple Go script) and an eval set for regression monitoring. Will add notes about embedding batching windows to avoid peak interference.
ops-bot: ticket created "latticelabs-regional-dedicated-proposal" assigned to @Diego @Sam @Priya due_in: 4 business days.
Diego (AM): Any renewal risk to flag? Their current usage is steady but this expansion looks like clear upsell. We should still monitor cost pushback during pricing review.
Maya (CS): No churn signals. Main risk: latency at tail and inter-region replication costs. We'll document mitigation and include Optimize recommendations: prefix caching, KV TTL tuning, and offload heavy offline embeds to batch windows.
Sam (Eng): Technical note: suggest session-length KV buckets (per-user session id) to reduce repeated prompt compute and keep KV cache compact. Also recommend warmup traffic 48h before cutover.
Maya (CS): I'll share the one-pager before EOD tomorrow and lock the kickoff. Thanks all :rocket:
Diego (AM): I'll drop pricing scenarios here once done.
Priya (Solutions): Playbook draft ETA 72hrs.
Maya (CS): If anything urgent pops up DM me or drop here. Closing for now.
